newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 falls as Komercni slides on H1 results.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 falls as Komercni slides on H1 results.

text.p: The Czech PX50 dropped back on Thursday as the most heavily capitalised banking issue, Komercni Banka posted sharply lower first half profits.
The PX50 dropped by more than one percent to 508.6 while Komercni lost 39 crowns, 2.3 percent, to 1,621.
Analysts were unpleasantly surprised by the results which showed the bank's net profit falling to 1.64 billion crowns from 2.53 in the first half last year.
"H1: Bad but it will get worse," read the heading to an investment report on Komercni from ABN AMRO Hoare Govett.

The report, which was compiled straight after the results were anounced, continued: "Komercni's poor first half results are no one-off. Revenue will continue to go down as the economy takes on water, the share of non-performing loans remains inadequately covered."
Komercni put a brave face on the results saying that its volume of client loans and its assets had both risen and that costs and expenses had been cut.
The bank said its results testified to its "sustained growth potential."
